extracted.name: Earthquake Cookies
extracted.description: These earthquake cookies are so easy to make, you’ll probably crumble! You can use any flavor of cake mix you like, the possibilities are endless.
ingredient_lines: 1 (18.25 ounce) package devil's food cake mix
instruction_lines: Mix cake mix, eggs, shortening, and water in a medium-sized bowl; mix with a spoon. Chill for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C).
Shape dough into balls and roll in powdered sugar. Place on cookie sheets.
Bake in the preheated oven until browned, 8 to 10 minutes.
